option_relations.rationale: The clinical and histological features described in the vignette, such as the asymptomatic, gradually enlarging, reddish hematomalike plaque and the presence of poorly defined, superficial, and deep dermal vascular proliferation, are consistent with benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE), which is also known as targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma.
Lymphangioma does not match the clinical and histological features described in the vignette.
Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma (Dabska tumor) does not match the clinical and histological features described in the vignette.
